name: check_all
title: Check All
description: A "select all" checkbox that checks or clears a group of checkboxes and shows an indeterminate state when only some are checked.

attributes.name: data-check-all
attributes.description: Wraps the master checkbox and the checkboxes it controls.

attributes.name: data-check-all-target="dependant"
attributes.description: A checkbox controlled by the master checkbox.

attributes.name: data-check-all-action="check"
attributes.description: Runs the check action when the checkbox changes.

actions.name: check
actions.description: From the master checkbox: copies its state to every dependant. From a dependant: updates the master checkbox to checked, unchecked or indeterminate.

notes: The master checkbox is synced once when the root connects, so server-rendered checked states are reflected immediately.
See the table component for a selectable table built with check_all.
